headline.label: Opus 5.5
headline.source: LOOP.md closing report: level 4 as shipped, graded against the round-11 reference

reference.what: Adds capacity to quotes-svc before rolling it back, so the rollback starts no storm. Throttles each service only for the minute its fix lands.

moments.label: adds capacity first, then rolls back

r10-l4-s101-opus-155047-i52GNAA.what: Rolled back quotes-svc without adding capacity first: retries overloaded it and partner-api went to 72% errors. It also rejected 90% of pricing-svc's traffic for 23 minutes.
r10-l4-s101-opus-155047-i52GNAA.source: LOOP.md, round 10: one of the six of nine Opus runs that rolled the quiet fault's service back unprotected. Quotes are from its closing message in loop-evidence/final-messages.

moments.label: rolls back unprotected
moments.quote: The rollback itself set off a retry storm, and partner-api errors spiked to about 72% around minutes 45–51.
I rejected 90% of its requests for about 20 minutes to stop the storm, scaled it from 6 to 14 replicas, then lifted the limit.
I rejected 70% of quotes-svc requests for a few minutes and scaled it from 6 to 9 replicas, and partner-api went to 0% by minute 53.

r10-l4-s101-opus-155047-yZYAnrJ.what: Added capacity before rolling back quotes-svc, but rolled back the innocent returns-svc first ($10,000) and reached the quiet fault only at minute 74.
r10-l4-s101-opus-155047-yZYAnrJ.source: LOOP.md, round 10: protected the rollback but rolled back the innocent caller first and fixed late. Quotes are from its closing message in loop-evidence/final-messages.

moments.label: rolls back the innocent caller
moments.quote: I rolled back deploy `v121` because its timing matched partner-api's errors, but the change looked harmless and the errors came from quotes-svc.
moments.told: Not every alert or recent change is a cause

moments.label: scales first
moments.quote: Because quotes-svc ran close to capacity and its callers retry, I scaled it from 6 to 12 replicas before rolling the deploy back at minute 75.
I first took it for plain overload and spent time on scaling and two short throttles before reading its logs.

r10-l4-s101-opus-155047-pKMRL8v.what: Added capacity before rolling back quotes-svc and wasted nothing. Its loss is throttling: half of pricing-svc's and of sms-svc's traffic rejected for over 30 minutes each.
r10-l4-s101-opus-155047-pKMRL8v.source: LOOP.md, round 10: one of the two Opus runs that added capacity first and wasted nothing. Quotes are from its closing message in loop-evidence/final-messages.

moments.label: scales first
moments.quote: Added replicas first so retries during the rollback wouldn't overload it, then rolled back v59
Lifting the throttles is why mobile-api errors only fell gradually while I was still working on sms-svc.

r10-l4-s101-sonnet-153636.what: Two wasted rollbacks ($20,000) and a 90% throttle on pricing-svc for 41 minutes. It did add capacity before rolling back quotes-svc.
r10-l4-s101-sonnet-153636.source: The action log; LOOP.md round 10 gives its score only.

r10-l4-s101-gemini-153638.what: First action at minute 42. Rolled back quotes-svc without adding capacity, wasted two mitigations ($20,000) and fixed the mid-shift fault at minute 106.
r10-l4-s101-gemini-153638.source: The action log; LOOP.md round 10 gives its score only.

reference.what: Traces partner-api's unexplained errors down the callers' logs to quotes-svc, reads both changes of that minute and reverts the config.

r2-l3-s101-opus-112132.what: Finds every cause and wastes nothing, but hunts the quiet fault breadth-first: quotes-svc is fixed at minute 54, 28 minutes after the reference.
r2-l3-s101-opus-112132.quote: Partner-api was slow to fix. It ran at about 4.5% errors until minute 54, which is roughly $20k of lost revenue.
r2-l3-s101-opus-112132.source: LOOP.md, failure taxonomy of the first budget: meaningful, all of its loss is delay.

r2-l3-s101-gemini-112134.what: Rolled back returns-svc, the innocent caller of the quiet fault, then reverted and restarted the decoy cart-svc: three wasted mitigations, $30,000.
r2-l3-s101-gemini-112134.source: LOOP.md, failure taxonomy of the first budget
